basics.title: The law: open bars, illegal sex work, under-18s
basics.text: Selling and buying sex is illegal under Thailand's Prevention and Suppression of Prostitution Act (1996), even where bars work openly. Anyone under 18 is a child: sex with a person under 18 for money brings prison, and under the Criminal Code sex with a child under 15 means 5-20 years and a 100,000-400,000 THB fine, whatever the child says. Foreigners can also be tried at home. Since 28 Aug 2026 Thailand can deport foreigners without a conviction if their conduct is judged against public order or morals, and ban them from returning. Police may check your passport; a copy of the photo page is usually enough.

basics.title: Bangkok red-light areas by train
basics.text: Nana Plaza and Soi 4: BTS Nana. Soi Cowboy: BTS Asok or MRT Sukhumvit. Patpong, Thaniya and Silom Soi 2 and 4 are side by side: BTS Sala Daeng or MRT Silom. Ratchada (Golden Dome, Poseidon): MRT Sutthisan. Calypso at Asiatique: BTS Saphan Taksin, then the free boat from Sathorn Pier. BTS and MRT run about 06:00-24:00, so after midnight use Grab or a metered taxi, and do not ask drivers for bar tips.

basics.title: Closing times, ID and holy days
basics.text: In Bangkok, bars without an entertainment licence close at midnight and licensed venues at 02:00; only licensed venues in the Silom, RCA and Ratchadaphisek zones may stay open to 04:00, and Sukhumvit go-go bars close around 02:00-03:00. Shops and bars may sell alcohol 11:00-24:00 since 29 May 2026, with more freedom for licensed entertainment venues. The minimum age for drinking and for clubs is 20; bring your original passport. On Buddhist holy days alcohol sales stop and Nana Plaza closes, but none falls between 8 and 23 Jan 2027.

basics.title: Bills, lady drinks and photos in go-go bars
basics.text: Entry is usually free, but you pay for every drink, and a 'lady drink' for a dancer or hostess costs about 180-260 THB, or 350-400 THB for a double. Ask the price before you buy, and pay each round or check the bill (check bin) often; some bills add a service charge that is not on the menu. Never take photos inside: security reacts fast. Do not follow touts with show menus, especially upstairs in Patpong, where bills of 5,000-10,000 THB are reported. Carry only the cash you plan to spend.

basics.title: Drugs, raids and urine tests in Bangkok
basics.text: Police raid bars and give everyone urine tests, and drug use itself is a crime. On 10 Oct 2026 a raid on a Khao San Road bar found 31 people positive and 30 guests under 20; in Sep 2026 police tested 98 people in Wang Thonglang nightlife venues; in Jul 2026 police raided a pub hidden behind a game shop and arrested foreigners who tested positive. In Oct 2025 undercover police raided a drug den near Sukhumvit Soi 3, by Nana. Laughing gas balloons are illegal to sell (up to 5 years). Spiked drinks happen: do not leave a drink alone and do not accept drinks from strangers.

basics.title: Koh Phangan: Full Moon week risks
basics.text: Full Moon week (20-24 Jan 2027) brings more police and more stings. Drug sellers on the beach, at jungle parties and on Telegram may be police or informants; in Jan 2026 narcotics police arrested suppliers at the party, and tourists from a villa party were arrested and blacklisted. Mushroom shakes and laughing gas balloons are illegal even when sold openly. The UK government says attacks are most common at full moon parties and near bars late at night. Watch your drink, wear closed shoes, stay out of the sea at night and keep away from the fire rope.

basics.title: Koh Samui at night: Chaweng and Lamai
basics.text: Chaweng is the wild side: Soi Green Mango has the clubs, the go-go bars and Ballers strip club, and Soi Reggae has beer bars with pool. Lamai is calmer, with beer bars around the boxing ring. Koh Samui is in a 04:00 zone for licensed venues, but most bars close at 02:00-03:00. Late-night taxis often refuse the meter, so use Grab. In Dec 2025 a British tourist died at a Chaweng hotel after a night out; police looked into a theft by a person met at a venue and into drugs. Tourist Police: 1155.

basics.title: Kratom and vapes
basics.text: Kratom is a legal herb in Thailand under the Kratom Plant Act (2022): adults may buy and drink it, but shops may not sell to anyone under 18 or to pregnant or breastfeeding women, and mixing kratom with narcotics is illegal (fine up to 50,000 THB). Vapes and e-cigarettes are the opposite: it is illegal to have or use any vape, pod or heat-not-burn device, with no exception for tourists, and fines and arrests are common. Leave vapes at home.

priceGuide.bangkok: Go-go bars: entry free (Baccara: one drink at the door), beer 150-200 THB, lady drink 180-260 THB, double 350-400 THB. Cabarets 500-1,200 THB. Gentlemen's clubs: minimum spend about 3,000-5,000 THB per table.
priceGuide.koh-phangan: Full Moon Party entry 200 THB cash. Buckets about 150-400 THB, more on the beach than in the lanes; beer about 100 THB at the beach bars.
priceGuide.koh-samui: Beer bars: beer from 100 THB, lady drinks from 180 THB. Go-go: beer 120-180 THB, lady drink about 240 THB. Cabarets 250-790 THB with a drink.

items.name: Nana Plaza
items.coordSource: Google Maps place 'Nana Plaza' (!3d13.7413718!4d100.5533082), read 23 Oct 2026
items.gmapsQuery: Nana Plaza, Sukhumvit Soi 4, Khlong Toei, Bangkok
items.openText: Daily 19:00-02:00 (the plaza). Some bars inside list 03:00.
items.priceText: Entry free. Beer about 150-200 THB in most bars. Lady drinks about 200-250 THB, or 350-400 THB for a double.
items.description: A three-floor, U-shaped building at the end of Sukhumvit Soi 4, open since 1983. About 24 go-go bars and 3 beer bars sit around a courtyard, so it is the biggest go-go complex in Bangkok. Several bars on the upper floors have ladyboy dancers.
tips: BTS Nana, then about 300 m down Soi 4.
Start with a beer on the ground floor and look around. Billboard is on the top floor, Spanky's and Angelwitch on the 2nd.
Ask the price of a lady drink before you buy one, and pay each round so the bill does not grow.
No photos inside the bars. Security reacts fast.
Several bars have only ladyboy dancers. If you are not sure, ask.
The plaza closes on big Buddhist holidays (closed on 29-30 Jul 2026). No such holiday falls between 8 and 23 Jan 2027.
items.verification: Checked 23 Oct 2026. Google Maps: 4.1 from 16,224 reviews, open 7 PM-2 AM daily. Official site: '24 agogo bars and three stand-alone beer bars spread across three floors', open '7 days a week 7 pm to 2 am'. Wikipedia: opened 1983, about 300 m from BTS Nana, seven ladyboy bars as of July 2019. Stickman Weekly 26 Oct 2025: single lady drinks '200-250 baht', doubles '350-400+ baht'. Dave the Rave 26 Jul 2026: Nana closed for the double Buddhist holidays on 29-30 July. Billboard held its 11th anniversary here on 17 Oct 2026, so the plaza is trading.

items.name: Soi Cowboy
items.coordSource: Google Maps place 'Soi Cowboy' (!3d13.7370674!4d100.5618986), read 23 Oct 2026
items.gmapsQuery: Soi Cowboy, Sukhumvit Soi 23, Khlong Toei Nuea, Bangkok
items.priceText: Entry free in most bars; Baccara asks you to buy a drink at the door. Beer 150-200 THB, cocktails 180-300 THB, lady drinks 180-260 THB.
items.description: A 150 m pedestrian street between Sukhumvit Soi 21 (Asok) and Soi 23, lined with neon go-go bars on the ground floor and outdoor bars with street seating. About 20-25 go-go bars, all on one street, so it is easy to walk and compare. It feels more open than Nana Plaza.
tips: BTS Asok exit 3 or MRT Sukhumvit, 2-3 minutes on foot.
Busiest 21:30-24:00. Come before 21:00 for easy seats.
New bars: Hot Lips (Nov 2025) and Supernova (opened 1 Apr 2026).
No photos inside the bars.
Some bills add a service charge that is not on the menu. Check the bill (check bin) each round.
Tuk-tuk and motorbike drivers near Asok offer to take you to 'better' places. Say no.
items.verification: Checked 23 Oct 2026. Google Maps: 4.1 from 1,360 reviews. Wikipedia: about 150 m long between Soi 21 and Soi 23, near BTS Asok and MRT Sukhumvit, named after T. G. 'Cowboy' Edwards. Southeast Asia Simplified (2026): '20 to 25' go-go bars, open from about 7 PM, busiest 9:30 PM to midnight, beer 150-200 THB, cocktails 180-300 THB, lady drinks 180-260 THB, Baccara 'requires one drink purchase at the door', BTS Asok exit 3. Dave the Rave: Supernova opened 1 Apr 2026; Hot Lips opened mid-Nov 2025.

items.name: Patpong and Patpong Night Market
items.coordSource: Google Maps place 'Patpong Night Market' (!3d13.7292485!4d100.531574), read 23 Oct 2026
items.gmapsQuery: Patpong Night Market, Patpong Soi 1, Bang Rak, Bangkok
items.priceText: Entry free to the market and the ground-floor bars. Bargain hard at the stalls; many goods are fake. At King's Castle, table signs show beer at 60 THB (Google review, 2026).
items.description: Two short side streets between Silom and Surawong roads, Patpong 1 and Patpong 2. A night market of souvenirs and fake brands fills the middle of Patpong 1, with go-go bars on both sides; the first opened here in 1967. Touts with 'ping pong show' menus lead people to upstairs bars, which are a known scam (see the separate card).
tips: BTS Sala Daeng or MRT Silom, 3-5 minutes on foot.
Do not follow touts upstairs.
The market is liveliest 19:00-22:00.
Silom Soi 4 (gay and mixed bars) and Thaniya (Japanese clubs) are next door.
The Patpong Museum closed in 2023.
items.verification: Checked 23 Oct 2026. Google Maps: Patpong Night Market 3.7 from 20,057 reviews, 6 PM-1 AM daily. Wikipedia: Patpong 1 and 2 between Silom and Surawong roads, first go-go bar Grand Prix in 1967, night market since the early 1990s, museum closed as of May 2023, near BTS Sala Daeng and MRT Si Lom. King's Castle 1 on Google: 7 PM-2 AM; a 2026 review says the table signs show beer at 60 baht. thailandnightlife.net PSA of 17 Apr 2026 warns about touts and upstairs bars.

items.name: Thaniya Road (Japanese karaoke clubs)
items.coordSource: Google Maps street 'Thanon Thaniya' (!3d13.7294838!4d100.5335466), read 23 Oct 2026
items.gmapsQuery: Thaniya Road, Suriya Wong, Bang Rak, Bangkok
items.openText: Evenings and nights. By day it is an office street.
items.priceText: Prices differ by club. Ask for the full price (table charge, time and hostess drinks) before you sit down.
items.description: A 230 m street between Silom and Surawong roads, next to Patpong, with Japanese signs, Japanese restaurants and karaoke hostess clubs. Most clubs are for Japanese guests, and some take only Japanese guests.
tips: BTS Sala Daeng, 2-3 minutes on foot.
The Japanese restaurants are good and open to everyone.
Thaniya Plaza at the Silom end is a big golf shopping centre.
items.verification: Checked 23 Oct 2026. Wikipedia: about 230 m, links Silom and Surawong roads, 'an entertainment area' at night with karaoke bars and hostess clubs mainly for Japanese customers that also accept other nationalities; Thaniya Plaza (1989) is a golf centre. Wikivoyage Silom: 'Most bars and clubs are off-limits to Westerners', restaurants recommended. Google Maps shows the street with Japanese karaoke clubs such as Club Koi (4.4, 14 reviews).

items.name: Sukhumvit Soi 4 (Soi Nana) street bars
items.coordSource: Google Maps place 'Stumble Inn' at the mouth of Soi 4 (!3d13.7416326!4d100.5530706), read 23 Oct 2026
items.gmapsQuery: Stumble Inn, Sukhumvit Soi 4, Khlong Toei, Bangkok
items.openText: Bars open from late morning. Stumble Inn daily 10:00-02:00.
items.priceText: No entry fee. Pub prices; check the menu before you order.
items.description: The first 300 m of Soi 4, from Sukhumvit Road to Nana Plaza, is a strip of open-air pubs and beer bars, with Stumble Inn on the corner. It is loud and busy until late, and many freelance sex workers wait here, more so after the plaza closes. A good place for a beer and people-watching before or after Nana Plaza.
tips: BTS Nana, 1-2 minutes on foot.
Stumble Inn has a 4.1 rating from 628 Google reviews (23 Oct 2026).
The old Soi 7 Beer Garden across Sukhumvit is marked 'temporarily closed' on Google (23 Oct 2026).
Keep phone and wallet in front pockets in the crowd.
Police ran an undercover drug bust near Sukhumvit Soi 3 on 15 Oct 2025. Never buy from street dealers.
items.verification: Checked 23 Oct 2026. Google Maps: Stumble Inn 4.1 from 628 reviews, 10 AM-2 AM daily; Beer Garden Sukhumvit Soi 7 shows 'Temporarily closed' (3.7, 684 reviews). Wikipedia (Nana Plaza): 'Soi 4 outside has street prostitution, beer bars, and massage parlors'. Stickman 17 Aug 2025: Stumble Inn 'always has plenty of punters', Soi 4 'constant chaos'; 26 Oct 2025: most bars close around 3 AM, then freelancers gather in front of Stumble Inn. Khaosod 16 Oct 2025: undercover drug raid near Sukhumvit Soi 3 on 15 Oct.

items.name: Billboard (Nana Plaza)
items.coordSource: Google Maps place 'Billboard Bangkok Go-Go Bar Nana Plaza' (!3d13.7413161!4d100.5532654), read 23 Oct 2026
items.gmapsQuery: Billboard Go Go Bar, 3rd floor, Nana Plaza, Sukhumvit Soi 4, Bangkok
items.priceText: Entry free. Stickman (Aug 2025) calls it good value. Ask the lady drink price before you buy one.
items.description: The biggest go-go bar in Nana Plaza, on the top floor, with more than 100 dancers on two stages: a rotating carousel stage and a stage with a jacuzzi. It held its 11th anniversary party on 17 Oct 2026.
tips: Top floor of Nana Plaza.
Reviews are mixed: some praise calm, not pushy service; one reports wrong change. Count your change.
Anniversary and theme nights are very busy; Dave the Rave posts the dates.
items.verification: Checked 23 Oct 2026. Google Maps: 3.4 from 194 reviews, 8 PM-3 AM daily, 3rd floor. Official site: top floor, carousel stage and jacuzzi, more than 100 dancers on two stages, '8 p.m. until late'. Dave the Rave 20 Oct 2026: photos of the 11th anniversary party on 17 Oct. Stickman 17 Aug 2025: 'chugging along', good value.

items.name: Spanky's (Nana Plaza)
items.coordSource: Google Maps place 'Spanky's' (!3d13.7416146!4d100.5532215), read 23 Oct 2026
items.gmapsQuery: Spanky's, 2nd floor, Nana Plaza, Sukhumvit Soi 4, Bangkok
items.priceText: Entry free. Drinks from the bar menu; ask the lady drink price first.
items.description: A busy go-go bar on the 2nd floor of Nana Plaza, known for fun, playful shows and theme nights such as Mexican tequila nights. Stickman (Aug 2025) called it 'the funnest gogo bar in the plaza', and reviewers say the staff are not pushy.
tips: Weekends are busier, with more guests and more dancers.
Its anniversary party is each February (17th anniversary on 11 Feb 2026).
Phone +66 2 255 5720 or LINE @spankys.
items.verification: Checked 23 Oct 2026. Google Maps: 4.1 from 352 reviews, 7:30 PM-3 AM daily; review snippets 'staffs weren't pushy on the drinks', 'Weekend has more people'. Official site: 2nd floor of Nana Plaza, 'Doors open 19:30', Mexican Night promotion in October. Stickman 17 Aug 2025: 'the funnest gogo bar in the plaza'. Dave the Rave: 17th anniversary 11 Feb 2026.

items.name: Angelwitch (Nana Plaza)
items.coordSource: Google Maps place 'Angelwitch Rock Dancers Go-Go Bar Nana Plaza Bangkok' (!3d13.7413541!4d100.5531208), read 23 Oct 2026
items.gmapsQuery: Angelwitch, Nana Plaza, Sukhumvit Soi 4, Bangkok
items.openText: Daily 19:00-03:00. Shows most nights from about 22:00 to midnight.
items.priceText: Entry free. Beer about 150 THB (Wikivoyage; may have risen).
items.description: A go-go bar on the 2nd floor of Nana Plaza with one stage and choreographed dance shows by costumed 'rock dancers'. Wikivoyage calls it a gentler start for couples and the curious.
tips: Come after 22:00 for the shows.
One reviewer was charged for a beer he did not order. Check the bill.
items.verification: Checked 23 Oct 2026. Google Maps: 3.8 from 121 reviews, 7 PM-3 AM daily; snippets 'good music and lively entertainment', 'Server keeps the money for the beer you didn't order'. Wikivoyage Sukhumvit: 2F Nana Plaza, choreographed shows most evenings 22:00-00:00, beer 150 baht, a 'gentler' introduction for couples.

items.name: Baccara (Soi Cowboy)
items.coordSource: Google Maps place 'Baccara' (!3d13.7370339!4d100.5626718), read 23 Oct 2026
items.gmapsQuery: Baccara, Soi Cowboy, Bangkok
items.priceText: You buy one drink at the door to enter. Beer about 180 THB, lady drinks over 200 THB.
items.description: The most famous go-go bar on Soi Cowboy, at the Soi 23 end, on two floors. Guests upstairs look down through a glass floor onto the stage below. Many guests are Japanese, Korean and Chinese tourists.
tips: Prices are higher than in most Soi Cowboy bars.
Reviews are mixed: some say it does not rip you off and is not pushy, others complain about the staff.
Very full on weekends.
items.verification: Checked 23 Oct 2026. Google Maps: 3.3 from 343 reviews, 7 PM-3 AM daily; snippets 'They don't rip you off for a start, and are not pushy on the lady drinks' and a complaint about treatment. Theo Courant (updated 11 Sep 2026): beer 180 THB, lady drink 'over 200 THB', mostly Japanese, Korean and Chinese guests, upstairs view. Southeast Asia Simplified 2026: drink required at entry, premium pricing, Soi 23 end. Dave the Rave: open for Songkran 2026.

items.name: Tilac (Soi Cowboy)
items.coordSource: Google Maps place 'Tilac' (!3d13.7371442!4d100.5622431), read 23 Oct 2026
items.gmapsQuery: Tilac Bar, Soi Cowboy, Bangkok
items.priceText: Entry free. Beer about 150 THB, lady drinks about 200 THB.
items.description: One of the oldest and biggest go-go bars on Soi Cowboy, with mirrors, large screens and a modern light show. It appears in the film The Hangover Part II.
tips: Reviewers praise the cocktail prices and a friendly owner; one found drinks above average.
In the middle of the street.
items.verification: Checked 23 Oct 2026. Google Maps: 3.9 from 301 reviews, 7 PM-2 AM daily; snippets 'great prices on cocktails', 'Above average price for drinks'. Theo Courant (updated 11 Sep 2026): classic and one of the oldest, beer 150 THB, girls' drink 200 THB. Southeast Asia Simplified 2026: one of the oldest bars, featured in The Hangover Part II.

items.name: Crazy House (Sukhumvit Soi 23)
items.coordSource: Google Maps place 'Crazy House' (!3d13.7368368!4d100.562765), read 23 Oct 2026
items.gmapsQuery: Crazy House, Sukhumvit Soi 23, Bangkok
items.priceText: Entry free. Reviewers say staff push for drinks, and one says you pay up front.
items.description: A big go-go bar just off the Soi 23 end of Soi Cowboy, which guides call the most intense bar in the area. The same group runs Bad Beach and the new Supernova on Soi Cowboy.
tips: Decide your budget before you go in.
Supernova, the group's newest bar (opened 1 Apr 2026), has lady drinks at 200 THB and stunt shows after 22:00 and after midnight.
Packed and loud; some love the energy, some find it pushy.
items.verification: Checked 23 Oct 2026. Google Maps: 3.5 from 714 reviews, 7 PM-2 AM (Fri 2:30 AM); snippets 'packed with a great vibe', 'rude, pushy', 'you take money upfront'. Southeast Asia Simplified 2026: off-street on Soi 23, 'the most intense option'. Dave the Rave 8 Apr 2026: Supernova opened 1 Apr by the Crazy House Group, lady drinks 200 baht, stunt shows after 10 p.m. and midnight.

items.name: Hot Lips (Soi Cowboy)
items.coordSource: Google Maps place 'Hot Lips Soi Cowboy' (!3d13.7367828!4d100.5624382), read 23 Oct 2026
items.gmapsQuery: Hot Lips, Soi Cowboy, Bangkok
items.priceText: Entry free. Reviewers call the prices good and fair.
items.description: A go-go bar with a big street-front deck, opened in mid-November 2025 in the former Stumble Inn Soi Cowboy and run by the Stumble Inn Group. Red velvet stadium seats, a low stage close to the guests and a smoke-free room; it also serves food.
tips: The best Google rating of the big Soi Cowboy bars (4.3, 23 Oct 2026), but part of the reviews may be from the older bar at this address.
Reviewers say staff are friendly and not pushy; confirm prices when you order.
items.verification: Checked 23 Oct 2026. Google Maps: 4.3 from 613 reviews, 7 PM-3 AM daily; snippets 'good prices, good food, staff is friendly but not pushy', 'We ordered drinks and confirmed the price beforehand'. Dave the Rave (Thailand Inner Circle, 20 Dec 2025): opened mid-November 2025 in the former Stumble Inn Soi Cowboy, red velvet stadium seating, low stage, smoke-free. Dave the Rave 9 Apr 2026: owner is the Stumble Inn Group.

items.name: Vicky's Secret (Soi Cowboy)
items.coordSource: Google Maps place 'Vickys Secret BKK' (!3d13.7369049!4d100.5621497), read 23 Oct 2026
items.gmapsQuery: Vicky's Secret, Soi Cowboy, Bangkok
items.priceText: Entry free. During its saver menu promotions (Feb and Apr 2026) local beer, spirits and shots cost 100 THB.
items.description: A go-go bar on Soi Cowboy known for theme parties (pirate New Year, Back to School, Christmas) and a cheap saver menu. It opens from late morning, so it is one of the few places on the street with daytime drinks.
tips: Few Google reviews. One says two dancers pushed them to order very expensive drinks; say no clearly if you do not want to buy.
Credit cards accepted (Google review).
items.verification: Checked 23 Oct 2026. Google Maps: 3.7 from 7 reviews, 11 AM-2 AM daily. Dave the Rave: 'Vicky's Saver Menu Resets Soi Cowboy Drink Prices to Sensible 100 baht' (3 Feb 2026); Songkran 2026 opening at 2 p.m. with 100 baht local beers, spirits and shots; Back to Skool party 10 Jan 2026; pirate New Year's Eve party.

items.name: King's Castle (Patpong)
items.coordSource: Google Maps place 'King's Castle 1' (!3d13.7285947!4d100.5319778), read 23 Oct 2026
items.gmapsQuery: King's Castle 1, 87 Patpong Soi 1, Bang Rak, Bangkok
items.priceText: Entry free. Table signs show beer at 60 THB (Google review, 2026).
items.description: A group of five bars on Patpong 1: Kings 1, Kings 2, Kings 3, Kings Corner and a sports and karaoke bar. King's Castle 1 is the classic ground-floor go-go bar, with posted prices, so it is a safer choice in Patpong than the upstairs show bars.
tips: One reviewer was charged 70 THB instead of the 60 THB on the table sign. Check the bill.
BTS Sala Daeng or MRT Silom.
items.verification: Checked 23 Oct 2026. Google Maps: King's Castle 1, 3.5 from 129 reviews, 7 PM-2 AM daily, 87 Patpong; review: 'The waiter says it's 70 baht and not 60 like every sign said on every table'. Official site: 'five unique bars, all located on the same soi': Kings 1, Kings 2, Kings 3, Kings Corner and Kings Sports & Karaoke Bar.

items.name: Patpong 'ping pong' shows (upstairs bars)
items.coordSource: Google Maps place 'Super Pussy' on Patpong 1 (!3d13.7290289!4d100.5317533), used as the pin for the upstairs show bars
items.gmapsQuery: Patpong Soi 1, Suriya Wong, Bang Rak, Bangkok
items.ratingSource: Google Maps, 23 Oct 2026 (Super Pussy, the best-known upstairs show bar)
items.priceText: Touts quote 150-200 THB entry. Reported bills: 3,200 THB for four people (Google review, 2026) and 5,000-10,000 THB (thailandnightlife.net, Apr 2026).
items.description: Touts in the Patpong night market carry laminated menus of sex show acts and lead visitors to upstairs bars. They quote a cheap entry; then the bill is several thousand THB for drinks you did not order, and doormen may block the exit until you pay. The shows are illegal under Thai obscenity law, and no upstairs bar gets good reviews.
tips: The advice on every forum: do not follow touts upstairs.
If you go anyway, pay for each drink when it comes and agree the full price at the door.
Carry only a little cash.
If you are threatened, call the Tourist Police on 1155.
Stickman (Oct 2025): XXX on Patpong 2 reopened as a ping pong show bar.
items.verification: Checked 23 Oct 2026. Google Maps: Super Pussy 1.4 from 82 reviews; review: 'Example: 4 people 150 baht = 600 baht Actual price: 3200 baht'. thailandnightlife.net PSA (17 Apr 2026): touts with 'Ping Pong Show' cards, bills of 5,000-10,000 baht, a bouncer grabbed a man's arm and he paid 5,000 baht to leave. Wikivoyage Silom: upstairs bills can run to 'thousands of bahts' and 'the dispute could become violent'. Travels + Tunes: ping pong shows are illegal under obscenity law. Reddit r/ThailandTourism (2025) excerpt: shows 'notoriously infamous for overcharging'. Stickman 26 Oct 2025: XXX (Patpong Soi 2) reopened as a ping-pong show bar.

items.name: Calypso Cabaret (Asiatique)
items.coordSource: Google Maps place 'Calypso Cabaret' (!3d13.7039688!4d100.5036413), read 23 Oct 2026
items.gmapsQuery: Calypso Cabaret, Asiatique The Riverfront, Charoen Krung Road, Bangkok
items.priceText: Show only 900 THB online (official site), about 1,200 THB at the box office. Thai dinner + show 1,400 THB; dinner cruise + show 1,500 THB.
items.description: A glitzy ladyboy cabaret at Asiatique The Riverfront: about one hour of song, dance and costume numbers by a transgender cast, from pop hits to Thai pieces, in a 540-seat theatre.
tips: BTS Saphan Taksin, then the free Asiatique shuttle boat from Sathorn Pier (about 10 minutes).
Book online for the 900 THB price.
Not adults-only: it suits all ages. It is in this list because it is a ladyboy show.
items.verification: Checked 23 Oct 2026. Google Maps: 4.3 from 3,160 reviews. Official booking page: 'Calypso cabaret show only 900 THB', 'Thai set dinner with thai performance + Calypso cabaret show 1,400 THB', dinner cruise bundle 1,500 THB. Official show page: 'In just one hour'. Trip Thai Tour (6 Aug 2026): shows 7:15 PM and 9:00 PM, box office 1,200 THB, 540 seats, BTS Saphan Taksin and free shuttle boat. A Trip.com review also mentions the 7:15 PM show.

items.name: Golden Dome Cabaret (Ratchada)
items.coordSource: Google Maps place 'Golden Dome Cabaret Show' (!3d13.7851483!4d100.5775258), read 23 Oct 2026
items.gmapsQuery: Golden Dome Cabaret Show, 252/5 Soi Ratchadaphisek 18, Huai Khwang, Bangkok
items.priceText: Online tickets from about USD 15 (about 500 THB) on Trip.com; VIP seats cost more. Photos with performers 100 THB each.
items.description: A ladyboy musical cabaret running since 1997 in its own domed theatre on Ratchadaphisek Soi 18. About 60-70 minutes, more than 10 acts with big costumes, and a photo session with the stars after the show.
tips: MRT Sutthisan exit 3, then 10-15 minutes on foot.
Book at least a day ahead.
Some reseller tickets are for foreigners only.
items.verification: Checked 23 Oct 2026. Google Maps: 4.3 from 396 reviews, 252/5 Soi Ratchadaphisek 18. Official site: daily showtimes 17:00, 18:30 and 20:00. Thrillark: 60-70 minutes, advance reservation, photos 100 THB per performer, MRT Sutthisan exit 3 and a 10-15 minute walk. Trip.com (Oct 2026): 'Today's ticket price: $15.48'. The strength is unknown, and shakes may have other chemicals added.
In Jan 2018 the army closed Bello Bar and Reggae Bar on Haad Rin for selling mushroom drinks and laughing gas.
In Nov 2025 police arrested a man in Ban Tai with 285 g of mushrooms that he sold to partygoers.
Foreigners can also be deported and banned from returning.

items.priceText: Entry free. Normal bar prices.
items.description: The main gay bar on Koh Samui, in central Chaweng off the beach road: pool, darts, games and pizza made from scratch, plus events such as fashion shows. Samui has no gay go-go bars; the scene is small and relaxed.
tips: Whisper Gay Bar/Lounge (5.0, 47 reviews) is another option in Chaweng.
Soi Green Mango and the cabarets are a few minutes away.
